name: Minamijuujisei Renka
source:
Ryousuke’s twin imoutos Rena and Rina are geniuses who had already finished all their university courses and now work at the research facility at the southern island nation of Guinberne. He was worried about them, wondering if they would overwork themselves and fall down. So, he decided to transfer to a school in Guinberne, where he was put into the ‘special treatment’ class full of peculiar students.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
凉介的双胞胎妹妹丽奈和莉娜是天才，他们已经完成了所有大学课程，现在在南部岛国金伯恩的研究机构工作。他很担心他们，担心他们会不会劳累过度而摔倒。于是，他决定转学到金伯恩的一所学校，在那里他被分到了一个充满特殊学生的“特殊待遇”班。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
